select * from ( select 'Opening' AS DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name, -1 AS SourceID, SUM(TABopening.Amount) as Amount, '' AS InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' AS InvoiceNumbers, '' AS InvoiceDocumentNo, '' AS DocumentNo, @FromDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 AS ForAlhajAmount from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount FROM ( Select 'Opening' as DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, openingTAB.CustomerID, openingTAB.Name, -1 AS SourceID, sum(openingTAB.Amount) as Amount, '' as InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, '' as DocumentNo, @FromDate as DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount From ( ---------- OPENING BALANCE VENDOR INVOICE ---------- SELECT 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID {7} WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate {4} GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID ) OpeningTAB GROUP BY OpeningTAB.CustomerID ,OpeningTAB.Name
UNION ALL
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 end ) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_InvoiceHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode {7} WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate {5} --and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId {8} {9}
UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate {0} {1} {6} GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' {7} WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate {0} {1} {6} GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments UNION ALL -----------Sale Invoice Header----------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 else SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 {1} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
{0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID {7} WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID NOT IN (SELECT InvoiceHeaderID FROM Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail) {3} GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount
UNION ALL -----------Sale Invoice Header Detail Data----------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, (case when Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType ='Credit' or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SUM(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount *-1) else SUM(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) end )Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType inner join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
{1} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID {0} inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID {7} WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate {3} GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType
union all --RECEIPT TRANSACTION SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID as SourceID, Case when ( select Amount from AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail rad where rad.TransactionType = 'Credit' and rad.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and rad.ReceiptAccountID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID ) is null then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 else AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 {1} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID {0} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID {7} WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID not in ( select ReceiptHeaderID from AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader RecHDR on RecHDR.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and RecHDR.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and RecHDR.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID inner join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and set_documentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID {7} where AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and set_documentType.documentType not like 'Carriage Contractor Adjustment' ) {4} GROUP BY AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID, AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID,AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, Comments, ReversalComments
UNION ALL -- Receipt Transaction Without Opening SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID as SourceID, Case when AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount else AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.Amount * -1 end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, [Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, [Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].ImportDocumentID as SourceID, Case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionType = 'Credit' then ([Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].TotalUnloadAmount) else ([Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].TotalUnloadAmount) * -1 end as Amount, -- (IMP_CustomClearing.TotalInvoiceAmount) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration ,'' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM GL_TransactionHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID=GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN [Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading] ON [Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].LoadingUnloadingID = GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 AND [Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].StatusCode=1 INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Loading%' INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON [Fabrics_LoadingAndUnloading].ContractorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} {1}
UNION ALL
SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.DiscountDate as DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.ImportDocumentID as SourceID, Case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionType = 'Credit' then (AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.TotalAmount) else (AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.TotalAmount) * -1 end as Amount, -- (IMP_CustomClearing.TotalInvoiceAmount) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration ,'' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo,AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.DiscountNo AS DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader INNER JOIN GL_TransactionHeader ON GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.DiscountNo AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.DocumentTypeID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.PeriodID
INNER JOIN SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID=GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PurchaseDiscountHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} {1}
-------------Transporter charges in in and OUt UNION ALL SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, null as SourceID, ISNULL((Case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionType = 'Credit' then (INV_StockTransactionHeader.TransportationCharges) else (INV_StockTransactionHeader.TransportationCharges) * -1 end),0) as Amount, --(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar*ISNULL(Rate,1)) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration ,'' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode=1 INNER JOIN GL_TransactionHeader ON GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.TransporterID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName ='Transporter' WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.TransportationCharges is not null {0} {1} UNION ALL
SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, null as SourceID, ISNULL(Case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionType = 'Credit' then (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LoadingCharges) else (INV_StockTransactionHeader.LoadingCharges) * -1 end,0) as Amount, --(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar*ISNULL(Rate,1)) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration ,'' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode=1 INNER JOIN GL_TransactionHeader ON GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.ContractorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName like '%Loading%' WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate AND iSNUll(INV_StockTransactionHeader.LoadingCharges,0) >0 {0} {1} UNION ALL SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, null as SourceID, ISNULL(SUM(Case when SET_DocumentType.TransactionType = 'Credit' then (INV_StockTransactionDetail.NetAmount) else (INV_StockTransactionDetail.NetAmount) * -1 end),0) as Amount, --(AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.AmountIndollar*ISNULL(Rate,1)) as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as DetailNarration ,'' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status=1 AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StatusCode=1 INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN GL_TransactionHeader ON GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID=INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.ImporterID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName='Stitching Contractor' WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Finish%' AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate {0} {1} group by SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo
) AS FINTAB GROUP BY DocumentType, CreateDate, CustomerID, NAME, SourceID, InstrumentNo, Comments,DetailNarration, InvoiceNumbers, InvoiceDocumentNo, DocumentNo, DocumentDate, FreightAmount, ForAlhajAmount ) as TAb -- For Transation type Filter {2} ) as FinalTAB where FinalTAB.Amount <> 0 Order By DocumentDate

( Select CustomerID,(sum(Payment)-sum(Receipt)) as Opening From ( (Select Sum (GrossAmount) Payment, 0 Receipt,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID from AP_PaymentDetail inner join AP_PaymentHeader on AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID and AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentDetail.PeriodID and AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = 23989 Group By AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID {Filter} ) Union all (Select 0 Payment,Sum (GrossAmount) Receipt,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID from AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID =AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID =AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID =AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID inner join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID where AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID =23989 Group By AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID) {Filter} )Tab Group By Tab.CustomerID )
(Select PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, PaymentDetail.GrossAmount as credit,EmployeePayment.CustomerID, EmployeePayment.CustomerName as PaymentCustomer from AP_PaymentHeader as PaymentHeader inner join AP_PaymentDetail as PaymentDetail on PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID = PaymentHeader.PaymentID And PaymentDetail.CompanyID = PaymentHeader.CompanyID And PaymentDetail.PeriodID = PaymentHeader.PeriodID Inner Join SET_DocumentType as PaymentType on PaymentType.DocumentTypeID = PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID And PaymentType.CompanyID = PaymentHeader.CompanyID And PaymentType.PeriodID = PaymentHeader.PeriodID
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer as EmployeePayment on EmployeePayment.CompanyID = PaymentHeader.CompanyID And EmployeePayment.PeriodID = PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND EmployeePayment.CustomerID = PaymentHeader.VendorID

select null As CreateDate, null as SourceHeaderID, B As BusinessPartnerName, null As PaymentAmount, null As ReceiptAmount, null as FreightAmount, null as FreightAmountDR, null as FreightAmountCR, null As InstrumentNo, null As Comments, null As Type, null As DocumentNo, '' as DocumentType, '' As Item, '' AS ItemCategoryName, '' as Chassis, null As DocumentDate, sum(A) as sum, '' as 'Row' from ( Select isnull(Sum(SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid), 0) As A, null as SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS B From AR_SET_Customer Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode left Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 Where AR_SET_Customer.PeriodId = @PeriodId and AR_SET_Customer.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber is not null and SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid >= 0 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @Fromdate {Filter}
group by AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName
Union All
Select isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) * -1 As A, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS B From AR_SET_Customer Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Inner JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/AR/Transaction/Receipt_Transaction_frm.aspx', '/AR/Transaction/Partial_Receipt_frm.aspx') Where AR_SET_Customer.PeriodId = @PeriodId and AR_SET_Customer.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @Fromdate {Filter}
group by AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.SourceHeaderID ) tb group by B
Union All
SELECT distinct SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate, null as SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BusinessPartnerName, isnull(SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount, 0) as PaymentAmount, '0' AS ReceiptAmount, 0 as FreightAmount, 0 as FreightAmountDR, 0 as FreightAmountCR, AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo, '' As Comments, @BPTypeCode As Type, isnull(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, 0) as DocumentNo, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , inv_Item.Description As Item , INV_SET_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategoryName,[SAL_DOVehicleInformation].Chassis, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate as DocumentDate, '' as sum , '' as 'Row' FROM AR_SET_Customer Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
Left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
Left join AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyId AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode = 1
LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
left join SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation on SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID AND SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN [SAL_DOVehicleInformation] ON [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[DOVehicleInformationID] = [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[VehicleInformationID]
----- for item And Catagoery
Left JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
Left JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
Left JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 Left JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1

SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode -- AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID -- AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID -- left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID -- And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 -- Inner JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID -- AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 --Where AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.PeriodId = @PeriodId and AR_SET_Customer.status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber is not null -- and SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid >= 0 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate >= @Fromdate AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate <= @Dateto -- --AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID in (2) AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BPTypeCode -- AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID in (41) AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BPTypeCode --group by SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, -- GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType
Union All SELECT AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.SourceHeaderID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BusinessPartnerName, '0' as PaymentAmount, isnull(sum(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount), 0) as ReceiptAmount, '0' as FreightAmount, '0' as FreightAmountDR, '0' as FreightAmountCR, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo as InstrumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, @BPTypeCode As Type, isnull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) as DocumentNo,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , '' As Item,'' AS ItemCategoryName,'' as Chassis,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate as DocumentDate, 0 as sum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName) as 'Row' FROM AR_SET_Customer Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 Inner JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 INNER JOIN ApplicationMenu ON ApplicationMenu.MenuID = Set_DocumentType.MenuID AND ApplicationMenu.MenuPath in ('/AR/Transaction/Receipt_Transaction_frm.aspx', '/AR/Transaction/Partial_Receipt_frm.aspx') Where AR_SET_Customer.PeriodId = @PeriodId and AR_SET_Customer.status = 1 and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo is not null AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @Fromdate AND @Dateto --AND AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID in (2) AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = @BPTypeCode {Filter} group by AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate,AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.SourceHeaderID ,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType
-- for item Record Against Dispatch
SELECT distinct AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BusinessPartnerName, isnull(SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, 0) as DocumentNo, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType , inv_Item.Description As Item , INV_SET_Category.CategoryName AS ItemCategoryName,[SAL_DOVehicleInformation].Chassis FROM AR_SET_Customer Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartner On AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left Join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1
left join AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail on AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.ReceiptHeaderID AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyId = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.CompanyId AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionDetail.PeriodID
left Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyId = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyId And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 And SAL_DispatchHeader.StatusCode = 1
LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN Set_DocumentType ON Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1
left join SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation on SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.DispatchID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID AND SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
left JOIN [SAL_DOVehicleInformation] ON [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] And [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[DOVehicleInformationID] = [SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation].[VehicleInformationID]
----- for item And Catagoery
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1
INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DODetailID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceLineID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[SourceHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader] ON [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[DeliveryOrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[DOHeaderID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemCategoryID] --AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[ItemID] --AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1
Where AR_SET_Customer.PeriodId = @PeriodId and AR_SET_Customer.status = 1 and SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo is not null and SAL_DispatchHeader.TotalAmount >= 0 AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate >= @Fromdate AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate <= @Dateto {Filter} {0} --group by SAL_DispatchHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate, -- GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID ,inv_Item.Description,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Set_DocumentType.DocumentType,SAL_DispatchVehicleInformation.Chassis,AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.InstrumentNo

data.name: Query_GetDataForPaymentOverDewReport
data.value:
Select * from ( select CustomerID ,Name as CustomerName ,'' as InvoiceNumber ,'' as InvoiceDate ,'' as LotNo,0 as InvoiceAmount ,0 as ReceivedAmount , '' as OFDays , 0 as Balance ,'0' as Terms ,Amount as Opening from ( select 'Opening' AS DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name, -1 AS SourceID, SUM(TABopening.Amount) as Amount, '' AS InstrumentNo, '' Comments, 0 AS InvoiceNumbers, '' AS InvoiceDocumentNo, '' AS DocumentNo, @FromDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 AS ForAlhajAmount from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount FROM ( Select 'Opening' as DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, openingTAB.CustomerID, openingTAB.Name, -1 AS SourceID, sum(openingTAB.Amount) as Amount, '' as InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, 0 as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, '' as DocumentNo, @FromDate as DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount From ( ---------- OPENING BALANCE VENDOR INVOICE ---------- SELECT 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID ) OpeningTAB GROUP BY OpeningTAB.CustomerID ,OpeningTAB.Name
UNION ALL
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount from ( ---------- Vendor Invoice ---------- SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID = CUS.TypeCode ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else (AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid) * -1 end ) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate
--and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId
UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID and AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' INNER JOIN UsersInDocumentType ON UsersInDocumentType.CompanyID = SET_DocumentType.CompanyID AND UsersInDocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID AND UsersInDocumentType.UserID = @UserID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
